dialects.turnControl: server-vad or manual input_audio_buffer.commit; commit itself triggers translation
dialects.commitSemantics: response.text.done or response.audio_transcript.done commits translated text
dialects.responseTrigger: server-vad or input_audio_buffer.commit; response.create is forbidden

dialects.turnControl: server-vad or manual input_audio_buffer.commit followed by response.create
dialects.commitSemantics: response content done events commit one response; response.done is not a session terminal

dialects.turnControl: server-vad, push-to-talk, or smart_turn with product-specific invalid-turn handling
dialects.commitSemantics: product-specific transcription and response done events commit a turn
dialects.responseTrigger: automatic or response.create according to the configured Qwen-Audio turn mode

dialects.turnControl: binary audio is forbidden until task-started
dialects.commitSemantics: result-generated sentence_end=true commits the sentence identity

dialects.turnControl: binary audio is forbidden until task-started
dialects.commitSemantics: result-generated sentence_end=true commits the sentence identity

dialects.turnControl: binary audio is forbidden until task-started; Paraformer parameters remain profile-local
dialects.commitSemantics: result-generated sentence_end=true commits the sentence identity

dialects.turnControl: binary audio is forbidden until task-started
dialects.commitSemantics: final transcription and translation sentence identities commit independently

dialects.turnControl: continue-task text is forbidden until task-started
dialects.commitSemantics: binary audio after result-generated belongs to that task and task-finished commits the task

dialects.turnControl: all input text is carried by the one-shot run-task payload
dialects.commitSemantics: binary audio belongs to the one-shot task; task-finished commits the task
response.audio.done commits one audio response; response.done does not replace session.finished

dialects.turnControl: Started is not media-ready; binary audio is forbidden until DialogStateChanged(Listening)
dialects.commitSemantics: application directives and dialog-state transitions own turn completion
response.text.done or response.audio_transcript.done commits translated text
dialects.responseTrigger: server-side turn detection; response.create is forbidden
